prompt:
We're building a quality assurance pipeline for our AI counseling platform. In the workspace under sessions/incoming/, there are three JSON files representing client messages from different sessions. Each file contains the client's message, the session ID, and which exchange number this is in the conversation.

Your job is to act as the Love Counselor defined in the platform's SKILL.md and produce a properly formatted response for each of the three sessions. Save each response as a text file named after the session ID (e.g., response_S101.txt) somewhere in the workspace.

The platform has very specific requirements about how responses must be structured, what language they must be written in, when certain platform upgrade messages must be included, and how safety situations must be handled. All of these rules are documented in SKILL.md. Your responses will be automatically graded for strict compliance.
